content: SITE Hyderabad mein bari aag lag gayi hai! Hatri Road pe factory se aag nikal rahi hai — black smoke poori tarha se nazar aa raha hai. Log bhaag rahe hain. #HyderabadFire
Chemical factory fire at SITE Hyderabad — 3 explosions heard. Workers running out. Hatri Road completely blocked. Sindh fire brigade kahan hai? Someone is still trapped inside.
Qasimabad Hyderabad mein baarish ke baad galiyan talaab ban gayi hain! Auto Baan Road bhi doob gayi. WASA ka koi system hi nahi hai. Gaarian phas gayi hain. #HyderabadFlood

Rescue 1122 Sindh, Hyderabad Unit: Chemical factory fire at SITE — Jubilee Chemical Industries. Fire spread to solvent storage — 3 secondary explosions. 2 workers trapped confirmed. Foam suppression underway. 500m exclusion zone. Toxic fumes drifting SW toward residential Latifabad.

WASA Hyderabad Emergency: Qasimabad drainage failure — main storm sewer blocked at 3 junctions. Water depth 60cm on Auto Baan Road. 400 households inundated. Pumping commenced — drain clearance ETA 6 hours.
Sindh EPA Air Monitor HYD-AQ03 (Latifabad): VOC spike 28× baseline. Benzene detected at 4.2 ppm (safe: 0.005 ppm). PM2.5: 634 µg/m³. Toxic plume confirmed from SITE fire moving SW.
Hatri Road SITE area — blocked by fire engines + exclusion zone. Auto Baan Road Qasimabad — flooded. Speed 0km/h both routes. City traffic severely disrupted.
Rescue 1122 Hyderabad: 31 calls — 18 fire-related (SITE area), 13 flood rescue (Qasimabad). 2 confirmed trapped in factory fire. 7 families on rooftops in Qasimabad flooding.
Hyderabad: 32mm/hr rain, 29°C, humidity 87%. Rain continues — Qasimabad drainage already at capacity. SITE area toxic plume drifting SW in light 8km/h winds.
